name: What is the difference between a cosmetic remodel and a full interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a cosmetic interior remodel and a full interior remodel, and how do I know which one I need?
mainEntity.text: What is the difference between a cosmetic interior remodel and a full interior remodel, and how do I know which one I need?

acceptedAnswer.text: A cosmetic remodel focuses on what you see, while a full interior remodel can change how the home functions. Cosmetic work usually includes paint, flooring, hardware, lighting updates, and sometimes cabinet refacing or countertop replacement. A full remodel may involve moving walls, changing the room layout, replacing cabinetry, upgrading plumbing and electrical, and improving storage or circulation. The right choice depends on how much the space fails to meet your needs. If the issue is mostly dated finishes, cosmetic work may be enough. If the room feels tight, poorly lit, or disconnected from the rest of the house, a full remodel is usually more effective. In older Los Angeles homes, the best solution often comes from a mix of both: keep what works structurally and redesign the areas that limit daily use.
acceptedAnswer.description: A cosmetic remodel changes surface finishes such as paint, flooring, fixtures, and cabinet refacing without major layout or system work. A full interior remodel may include wall changes, plumbing, electrical, lighting, cabinetry replacement, and room reconfiguration. If the space functions poorly or feels cramped, a full remodel may be the better fit.
